description: Corrections found by checking contests against a named source. Each record names the imported file, the source that shows the right figures, and why. The raw file stays as imported; scripts/build-test2-election-manifest.mjs (applySourceCheckedFixes) lays the operations over it at build time and shows the reason in the contest's 'Corrected' note. Operations: set {path, value}; candidate {name, set}; addCandidate {row}; replaceCandidates {candidates}.

batches.ni-and-dail-2026-10-18: Northern Ireland local government 1973-2011, the 1996 Forum (Belfast East) and two 2014 Dáil by-elections, checked against ARK Northern Ireland Elections, Wikipedia and ElectionsIreland.org.
batches.roi-local-2026-10-18: Irish local elections checked against IrelandElection.com (the independent check) and ElectionsIreland.org (the site Civgraph's figures were first taken from): winners not marked as elected, seat counts, quotas, and contests imported with no candidates or no votes, filled only where every candidate has a first preference that adds up to the page's valid poll and the winners equal the seats. Fills for 1974, 1979 and 1985 apply when those years are published.
batches.dail-byelections-2026-10-18: Dáil by-elections 2009-2021 imported with second-count figures as first preferences, missing candidates or a stray row, checked against ElectionsIreland.org and Wikipedia.
batches.official-records-2026-10-23: Results contradicted by official membership records: Dáil winners and Ceann Comhairle automatic returns (Houses of the Oireachtas, with ElectionsIreland.org and Wikipedia), NI Assembly and Westminster winners (NI Assembly, UK Parliament), and 2014 and 2019 council candidates the import left named 'Party' (ARK Northern Ireland Elections, Democracy Club, CC BY 4.0).
batches.eoni-2014-2026-10-26: Northern Ireland local council election of 22 May 2014, every contest checked candidate by candidate and stage by stage against the Electoral Office for Northern Ireland's result sheets as published on Open Data NI (Open Government Licence).
batches.eoni-wayback-2026-10-26: Northern Ireland council contests checked against the Electoral Office for Northern Ireland's own result sheets and results booklets, retrieved from the Internet Archive's copies of eoni.org.uk. Figures from the scanned booklets were read from the page images, not taken from OCR, and confirmed by the site owner.
